plays.name: GSA & Municipal Set-Aside Pass-Through Facility Ghost-Brokering
plays.mechanism: Match eligible facility-service primes with disclosed qualified subcontractors and earn documented coordination fees; opaque pass-throughs and false set-aside eligibility are excluded.
inputs: Licensed local vendor bids and capacity records
workflow: 1. Screen solicitations for service scope, eligibility, and permitted subcontracting
2. Verify the prime performs required work and disclose broker and subcontractor roles
3. Submit priced delivery plans with genuine vendor commitments and required certifications
4. Track service acceptance, payroll obligations, and authorized fee payments against contract terms

platform_risks.failure_mode: Set-aside eligibility protest or prohibited pass-through finding
platform_risks.trigger: Inaccurate certification or subcontracting beyond contract limits
platform_risks.impact: Termination, repayment demands, or debarment exposure
platform_risks.detection_metric: Unverified certifications and subcontracted work share versus permitted limits
platform_risks.fallback: Withdraw noncompliant bids and operate as a disclosed subcontractor on unrestricted work

plays.name: Commercial Hail-Swath Public Adjuster & Appraisal-Clause Storm Arbitrage
plays.mechanism: Match verified commercial storm damage with licensed public-adjuster capacity and policy-specific appraisal processes, distinguishing valuation disputes from coverage questions.
inputs: Public hail-swath data and property records
Policy forms and dated damage inspections
State licensing, solicitation, and fee-limit rules
workflow: 1. Map storm footprints to commercial properties and conduct permitted owner outreach
2. Obtain authorized inspections and licensed review of coverage, deadlines, and preexisting damage
3. Submit supported estimates and invoke appraisal only where the policy and dispute allow it
4. Reconcile settlement, repairs, and lawful disclosed fees without inflating losses
metrics: Days from inspection to resolved valuation
Net client proceeds after fees and deductible

platform_risks.failure_mode: Unauthorized adjusting or inapplicable appraisal demand
platform_risks.trigger: Unlicensed solicitation or use of appraisal to resolve excluded coverage issues
platform_risks.impact: Claim delay, fee forfeiture, and licensing penalties
platform_risks.detection_metric: License exceptions and appraisal requests rejected for coverage disputes
platform_risks.fallback: Pause solicitation and refer coverage disputes to qualified counsel while licensed adjusters handle supported valuations

plays.name: MCA UCC-1 Trigger Stacking & Dual-Sided Default-Restructure Brokerage
plays.mechanism: Use UCC filing changes to identify businesses that may need cash-flow review and consensual MCA restructuring, with verified obligations and disclosed compensation rather than encouraging undisclosed stacking.
inputs: Public UCC filings and termination records
Broker licensing rules and disclosed creditor compensation terms
workflow: 1. Treat UCC changes as outreach signals, not proof of default, and obtain merchant authorization
2. Reconcile advances, liens, repayment pulls, covenants, and sustainable payment capacity
3. Disclose dual-sided fees and conflicts; use independent counsel where representation would conflict
4. Coordinate documented creditor-approved modifications and monitor actual payment relief
metrics: Net merchant payment relief after fees

platform_risks.failure_mode: Conflicted brokerage or prohibited stacking worsens default
platform_risks.trigger: Hidden commissions, inaccurate balances, or new financing breaching existing contracts
platform_risks.detection_metric: Undisclosed fee exceptions and covenant breaches per engagement
platform_risks.fallback: Stop placement, refund improper fees, and refer the merchant to independent licensed restructuring counsel

plays.name: TCPA Serial-Plaintiff Docket Scraping & Real-Time Litigator-Scrub Firewall Tollbooth
plays.mechanism: Offer consent-first outbound compliance screening using lawful docket-derived risk signals alongside mandatory do-not-call and revocation checks; plaintiff matching neither authorizes contact nor replaces TCPA compliance.
inputs: Permitted public docket data with identity confidence scores
Consent provenance, revocations, and suppression lists
Applicable calling rules and customer retention policies
workflow: 1. Ingest permitted docket records with source dates, minimization, and human identity review
2. Check consent, do-not-call status, revocations, and calling restrictions before optional risk enrichment
3. Suppress noncompliant contacts and route uncertain matches to review without planting honeypots or provoking claims
4. Serve auditable screening decisions with correction, deletion, and retention controls
metrics: Contacts blocked for missing consent or suppression match

platform_risks.failure_mode: False identity match or false assurance of permission to call
platform_risks.trigger: Stale docket data or treating absence from a plaintiff list as consent
platform_risks.impact: Unlawful outreach, privacy complaints, and customer liability
platform_risks.detection_metric: Consent-audit failure rate and upheld identity correction requests
platform_risks.fallback: Disable uncertain enrichment and require independently verified consent and authoritative suppression checks
